# Record parity

**Generated by `cargo xtask parity`; do not edit by hand.** Rerun it after a change to
`crates/schema/defs/`, to the `coverage` command, or to the corpus.

## Families

Per schema family (the lanes that typed them; `docs/schema/*-family.md`), summed over
the family's record types from the tables below: **Record types** seen in the corpus,
**Definitions** in the schema (with or without corpus records), **Records**, and
subrecord occurrences the definitions type, keep **Opaque**, or do not name
(**Unknown**). *container/other* holds every other type: TES4, GMST, GLOB, KYWD, the
lstring-only definitions, the inventory definitions and the types without a
definition.

Inventory definitions (M4.BX2 and the KK-1xx tickets; in *container/other*), 80: AACT, AAMD, AAPD, ADDN, AMBS, AOPF, AOPS, ARTO, ATMO, BMMO, BMOD, CAMS, CLDF, CLMT, COLL, CSTY, CUR3, DEBR, DLBR, DOBJ, DOOR, EFSH, EQUP, FFKW, FOGV, FORC, FSTP, GBFT, GCVR, GPOG, GRAS, GWED, IMAD, IMGS, IPDS, IRES, KSSM, LAYR, LENS, LGDI, LGTM, LIGH, LMSW, LSCR, LTEX, LVLB, MAAM, MATT, MESG, MOVT, MUSC, MUST, NAVI, NOCM, OSWP, OVIS, PERS, PGRE, PHZD, PSDC, PTST, REVB, RFGP, SCCO, SDLT, SECH, SFPC, SOUN, SPCH, SPGD, STAG, STBH, STND, TXST, VOLI, WBAR, WKMF, WTHR, WTHS, WWED.

## Corpus and method

- Corpus: the 14 files of `corpus/manifest.toml` (recorded 2026-10-14, manifest hash
  `fnv1a64:ab0c6a61395d23b1`), read in place from `KITKRAFT_DATA_DIR`; each file's
  size was checked against the manifest (the SHA-256 is not re-verified here).
- Every record type the files hold is counted, the plugin header `TES4` included (one
  per file). `kit coverage --matrix` (MX) has no row for `TES4`; the gap matrix
  headline (`docs/foothold/gap-matrix.md`) says so and counts 1 record type(s) and
  14 records fewer.
- Schema: 163 record definitions, defs hash `fnv1a64:f82447f067eff942` (the hash named in
  `crates/esm/src/generated/records.rs`).
- Counts come from `kit coverage <file> --json` (M1.14). Compressed records **were
  examined**: each was decompressed with the default `DecodeLimits` and its subrecords
  counted (136,741 of 136,741 compressed records examined).
  None failed to decode.
- Classification is by subrecord signature against the record type's definition,
  and `coverage` decodes every record of a defined type through its generated
  definition and encodes it again (M3.F2): a typed subrecord whose payload does not
  decode is counted as failed, not typed (see "Decoded through the definitions").

Columns:

- **Schema**: the definition's name, or `-` when the record type has no definition.
- **Records**: records of this type across the corpus; **Compressed**: how many of
  them are compressed.
- **Seen**: distinct subrecord signatures found in records of this type.
- **Typed** / **Opaque** / **Unknown**: of those, how many the definition gives a
  layout, keeps as raw bytes, or does not name (all of them when there is no
  definition). Subrecords inside an `any_until` run (a BFCB..BFCE body) are unknown.

## Decoded through the definitions

Per defined record type, from `kit coverage` (M3.F2): **Typed records** decoded
through the generated definition; **Decoded** typed subrecord occurrences whose
payload decoded, **Failed** those that did not (the payload does not fit the layout,
or the definition does not accept it at that position; kept raw); **Re-encode**
subrecord positions where encoding the decoded record did not reproduce the input.
The confidence columns split **Decoded** by the confidence of the member each
occurrence is placed in (by position, as the decoder places it; lane B round 4).

## Definitions by confidence

Subrecord definitions per record type (groups expanded) from `kit schema --json`
(M2.F9), by `confidence` (ADR 0004: `reference` documented in an allowed source,
`container-reference` a container fact from UESP's Skyrim pages that no official
file shows (ADR 0005 Amendment 5), `corpus` observed in the official files,
`ck-diff` checked against Creation Kit output, `verified` both). **Typed**
definitions give a layout; **Opaque** ones keep the payload as raw bytes. The
occurrence check fails when a `corpus` (or better) member never occurs, and when a
`container-reference` member does.

- `WATR`: `ANAM` (19), `DATA` (19), `DNAM` (19), `ENAM` (18), `FNAM` (19), `GNAM` (19), `HNAM` (18), `JNAM` (18), `LNAM` (18), `MNAM` (18), `NAM0` (19), `NAM1` (19), `QNAM` (18), `UNAM` (18), `WASH` (18), `XNAM` (3), `YNAM` (19)
- `DMGT`: `DNAM` (11)
- `CHAL`: `ATAF` (18), `ATAN` (18), `ATAV` (18), `ATCP` (10), `DESC` (18), `FULL` (18)

By design, REFR's FLCS, KSIZ, KWDA, VLMS and OPDS count as unknown: in REFR they
occur only inside the BFCB..BFCE base form component blocks (the component bodies the
definition keeps as raw subrecords, `common/BfcbBlock.toml`), not as REFR members.
